source: User-provided 6776-line Gigapack filename tree; frames/spritesheet.txt/license.txt bytes were not provided
goal: Ten divergent relic mechanics matched to ten verified Gigapack sprite families; preserve stage 1-10 relics

rules.all_derived_attacks: must not recursively trigger source effect
rules.combat_budget: reuse existing pools, event caps and timers
rules.vfx: gameplay logic separate from animation; parse real spritesheet.txt; never assume uniform grid or FPS

relics.title: 雷鸣中继
relics.eligible: At least one active projectile weapon
relics.effect: Within 2.5 s, 2 primary hits from different weapon IDs OR 4 primary hits from the same weapon trigger 2 non-recursive lightning hits on 2 other distinct enemies within 3.2 units; each 45% of triggering primary hit damage. Global cooldown 4 s. Reset counters after proc.

relics.title: 虚空收纳匣
relics.effect: Once per 16 s negate one incoming valid player damage event; store one charge. On next primary hit consume charge for non-recursive 1.6 radius pulse dealing 60% of that primary hit damage. Maximum stored charge 1.

relics.title: 折跃之瞳
relics.effect: Every 6th primary ranged projectile cast relocate that SAME shot via portal to 1.1 units in front of the farthest legal living enemy within 9 units; aim at enemy and reset projectile interpolation to exit position. No duplicate damage, extra projectile, or collision along teleport segment. If no legal target, fire normally and retain count progression.

relics.title: 死神点名
relics.effect: After 8 credited kills from primary/normal weapon lineage, and no more often than once every 6 s, select highest-HP valid visible normal enemy within 6 units; telegraph 0.6 s then execute that normal enemy if alive. If no normal target, instead hit one visible elite/boss for 75% of current primary weapon base damage. Execution kills do not count toward this relic or retrigger it.

relics.title: 律动破阵
relics.effect: Every 7th primary cast, if global cooldown 4.5 s elapsed, fire a 90-degree cone wave length 3 toward nearest enemy, dealing 55% of that casting weapon snapshot damage once per target. Derived cone cannot trigger cast/hit chains.

relics.title: 点金秘典
relics.effect: For each 6 newly-earned coins, grant 5 experience through existing progression mechanism; at most 3 awards per wave. Coin spending never reduces accumulated earned count. Extra awards beyond per-wave cap are not banked.

relics.title: 蚀毒棱印
relics.eligible: Equipped leaf AND at least one of spark/bubble/flame-sweep
relics.effect: Primary leaf hit marks enemy for 3 s. A LATER primary hit from spark, bubble, or flame-sweep consumes mark and deals non-recursive splash radius 1.4 for 50% of consuming primary hit damage. Per-target proc cooldown 1.2 s; mark cannot be set and consumed by same hit.

relics.title: 无伤心铃
relics.effect: After 10 credited kills without taking damage, gain one stored heart petal (max 3). On next actual HP-loss event consume one petal to heal 4 HP after damage, capped by max HP. Taking damage resets current kill streak. Heart animation plays only on real healing, not at full HP.

relics.title: 烟幕羽坠
relics.effect: After player dash, leave 1.5 s stationary smoke at dash origin, radius 1.6. Enemies in smoke are slowed 40% for 0.5 s (elite 20%; boss immune); smoke spawn cooldown 7 s. Does not interrupt attack windups or deal damage. Only one smoke field active.

relics.title: 升阶礼炮
relics.effect: When a level-up choice is confirmed, queue one salute to fire after unpausing: hit up to 4 distinct visible enemies within 8 units, each for 70% of equipped primary weapon base damage; no additional proc chains. Max 1 pending salute and none on gameover/menu. If no enemy, expire after 3 s without spawning FX.
